license_required.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board

name.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board

type.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board, which consists of 15 members.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant, and each officer, director, partner, manager, associate, and responsible managing employee thereof, shall not have committed acts or crimes that are grounds for denial of licensure under Section 480.

required.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for

experience_source.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for, and the general knowledge of the building, safety, health, and lien laws of the state and of the administrative principles of the contracting business

kind.value: construction experience in the classification applied for
kind.quote: the qualifying individual has had within the last 10 years immediately preceding the filing of the application, not less than four years experience as a journeyman, foreman, supervising employee, or contractor in the classification

exams.name: Contractor's License Examination
exams.notes: Written examination required; may be waived under certain circumstances per Section 7065.1 and 7065.2
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by CSLB or contracted public/private organization)
exams.quote: the registrar shall investigate, classify, and qualify applicants for contractors' licenses by written examination

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter shall expire two years from the last day of the month in which the license is issued

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The renewal fee for an active license for an individual owner shall be four hundred fifty dollars ($450) and may be increased to not more than five hundred sixty-three dollars ($563).

available.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state

requirements.value: Reciprocity available if the other state accepts CA qualifications and has professional qualifications and conditions of good standing at least equal to CA; trade examination may be waived if applicant provides written certification of good standing for previous five years.
requirements.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state, and if the board ascertains, on a case-by-case basis, that the professional qualifications and conditions of good standing for licensure and continued licensure are at least the same or greater in that state as in California.

exists.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board, which consists of 15 members.

regulatory_model.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

credential_type.quote: Contractors' licenses are to be issued to individual owners, partnerships, corporations, limited liability companies, and participating tribes, in accordance with this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

title_protection.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person to advertise for construction or work of improvement covered by this chapter unless that person holds a valid license under this chapter in the classification so advertised

scope_protection.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state under either of the following conditions: (1) The person is not licensed in accordance with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee as a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of funds received for a specific construction project or failure to account for their use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation, or for a specified purpose in the prosecution or completion of any construction project or operation, or failure substantially to account for the application or use of such funds or property on the construction project or operation for which such funds or property were received constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A willful departure in any material respect from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of building laws of the state or political subdivision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the state, or of any political subdivision thereof, or of any of the following references to or provisions of law, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action against a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make and keep records of all contracts, receipts, and disbursements as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements by a licensee of all of his or her transactions as a contractor...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact in obtaining or renewing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or a licensee in obtaining, or renewing a license, or in adding a classification to an existing license constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete any construction project for the price stated in the contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect on the part of a licensee to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract for such construction project or operation or in any modification of such contract constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter or combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person, or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person, or acting as agent or partner or associate, or otherwise, of an unlicensed person with the intent to evade the provisions of this chapter constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter, or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter, or to comply with the provisions of Section 7106 of the Public Contract Code, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing any willful or fraudulent act as a contractor that substantially injures another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The doing of any wilful or fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor in consequence of which another is substantially injured constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a contractor under a license except in the name of the licensee or in accordance with the personnel of the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued hereunder except: (a) in the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license, or (b) in accordance with the personnel of the licensee as set forth in the application for such license, or as later changed as provided in this chapter, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project with reasonable diligence causing material injury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure or refusal without legal excuse on the part of a licensee as a contractor to prosecute a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence causing material injury to another constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay moneys when due for materials or services in connection with contracting operations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful or deliberate failure by any licensee or agent or officer thereof, to pay any moneys, when due for any materials or services rendered in connection with his operations as a contractor, when he has the capacity to pay or when he has received sufficient funds therefor as payment for the particular construction work, project, or operation for which the services or materials were rendered or purchased constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify registrar of unsatisfied final judgment or failure to maintain required bond
disciplinary_grounds.quote: all licensees shall notify the registrar in writing of any unsatisfied final judgment imposed on the licensee. If the licensee fails to notify the registrar in writing within 90 days, the license shall be automatically suspended

bonding_required.quote: The board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee file or have on file a contractor's bond in the sum of twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000).

insurance_required.quote: the board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee have on file at all times a current and valid Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance or Certification of Self-Insurance

definition_quote.value: a contractor is any person who undertakes to or offers to undertake to, or purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by or through others, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, parking facility, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof
definition_quote.quote: a contractor is any person who undertakes to or offers to undertake to, or purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by or through others, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, parking facility, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof

methods_authorized.quote: For the purpose of classification, the contracting business includes any or all of the following branches: (a) General engineering contracting. (b) (1) General building contracting. (2) Residential remodeling contracting. (c) Specialty contracting.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: Every person licensed pursuant to this chapter shall include his license number in: (a) all construction contracts; (b) subcontracts and calls for bid; and (c) all forms of advertising, as prescribed by the registrar of contractors, used by such a person.

self_insurance_permitted.quote: (The name on the license or 'This contractor') is self-insured.

contract_must_be_written.quote: A home improvement contract and any changes to the contract shall be in writing and signed by the parties to the contract prior to the commencement of work covered by the contract

right_of_rescission_days.quote: You, the buyer, have the right to cancel this contract within three business days.

deposit_cap_fraction.quote: THE DOWNPAYMENT MAY NOT EXCEED $1,000 OR 10 PERCENT OF THE CONTRACT PRICE, WHICHEVER IS LESS.

deposit_cap_contract_threshold_usd.quote: if the aggregate contract price specified in one or more improvement contracts, including all labor, services, and materials to be furnished by the contractor, exceeds five hundred dollars ($500)

change_order_must_be_written.quote: A change-order form for changes or extra work shall be incorporated into the contract and shall become part of the contract only if it is in writing and signed by the parties prior to the commencement of any work covered by a change order.

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: If a contract for work on residential property with four or fewer units contains a provision for arbitration of a dispute between the principals in the transaction, the provision shall be clearly titled 'ARBITRATION OF DISPUTES.'

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: This chapter does not apply to a work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts if the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than one thousand dollars ($1,000)

fraud_offense_defined.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person to engage in any of the following acts, the commission of which is cause for disciplinary action against any licensee or applicant: (a) Using false, misleading, or deceptive advertising as an inducement to enter into any contract for a work of improvement

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter shall expire two years from the last day of the month in which the license is issued

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action of a license to act as a contractor by another state shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action in this state if the individual is a licensee, or applies for a license, in this state.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: No contractor that is required to be licensed under this chapter shall insert in any contract, or be a party, with a subcontractor that is licensed under this chapter to any contract which contains a provision, clause, covenant, or agreement which is void or unenforceable under Section 2782 of the Civil Code.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: Any waiver of this section shall be deemed contrary to public policy and shall be void and unenforceable.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: The contract shall include a statement that, upon satisfactory payment being made for any portion of the work performed, the contractor, prior to any further payment being made, shall furnish to the person contracting for the home improvement or swimming pool work a full and unconditional release from any potential lien claimant claim or mechanics lien

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: no person engaged in the business or acting in the capacity of a contractor, may bring or maintain any action, or recover in law or equity in any action, in any court of this state for the collection of compensation for the performance of any act or contract where a license is required by this chapter without alleging that they were a duly licensed contractor at all times during the performance of that act or contract

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: the board, in collaboration with the Public Utilities Commission, shall develop and make available a 'solar energy system disclosure document' or documents that provide a consumer, at a minimum, accurate, clear, and concise information regarding the installation of a solar energy system
